HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. NIGHT hall of the thousand-year house: timber, one oil lamp on the floor. WORM’S-EYE. ONE DEVICE: the lamp as a small bright disc; the magistrate fills the upper frame. Chunnyun (FACE AND GARMENTS from attached portrait) leaning in the doorway of the servant wing, one fist against the frame, mouth mid-question — not cartoon evil, bureaucratic cruelty, entitled, tired of being refused. Crushed blacks, #2a2a32 as the lamp catch on cheekbone and knuckles — real light, never a glow. Old-master night canvas. No text. No watermark. Webtoon figures in watercolor-and-oil world, movie tenebrism, crushed blacks, one hard key, composed for 2:1 letterbox crop. No text. No watermark.
